context_policy: First 18 runs used fresh subagents with no forked history. Final two runs were generated by the parent agent after fresh spawning and completed-agent follow-up both failed with agent thread limit reached.
dispatch_order: Seeded order in frozen experiment configuration; next entry dispatched as a slot becomes available.
resource_isolation: Separate run directories and generation contexts on one shared host, not separate machines or containers.
timing_limitation: Wall time includes documentation, tool exploration, builds, validation, and contention with concurrent runs. Do not treat it as isolated inference latency.
model_accounting: Exact model deployment/settings, token counts, and cost are unavailable from the generation interface and remain null.
prompt_review_status: The ten existing draft prompt revisions were hashed and copied unchanged for this exploratory pilot; no claim of independently calibrated difficulty or completed licensing review.
evaluation_scope: Preserved generation diagnostics and artifact integrity inventory; no calibrated judge scores or physical verification.
